description: Roommates' text chat written Mon Oct 19, 2026 in Los Angeles; the user is Elle. Misspellings outside the date phrases ('ill', 'replacment', 'dishwaser', 'shud probly') tempt a model to correct the quote, which then verifies only by fuzzy matching (>= 0.9). Dates are spelled correctly so the date path is not under test. Also a hedged intention written with misspelled hedge words that the hedge regex does not catch.
